name: Pigneau de Behaine
role: French bishop who acted as Nguyễn Ánh's diplomatic agent, took his son to France in 1787 and returned with volunteers and arms in 1789.
known_facts: Bishop and missionary who attached himself to Nguyễn Ánh's cause in the 1770s.
Signed the Treaty of Versailles of 1787 on Nguyễn Ánh's behalf.
Took Nguyễn Ánh's son Nguyễn Phúc Cảnh to France in 1787.
Returned to Gia Định in 1789 with weapons and French volunteers.
interpretation: Apparent age late forties, tall and slightly stooping, long narrow face, prominent nose, deep-set grey eyes, thin lips, grey hair receding at the temples; wears a plain black cassock with a silver crucifix on a chain, a wide-brimmed black hat, and a leather satchel on a shoulder strap.
